en.bilal-muhammad: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdullah narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Isa from al-Hasan b. `Ali b. Faddal from Tha`laba b. Maymun from Abi Jamila al-Mufaddal b. Salih from Aban b. Taghlub from Abi `Abdillah (as). He said:
Whoever swears by Allah whilst lying, Allah says: “Did you not find anyone else to lie upon besides Myself?!”
